# CLI Reference

<!-- Generated by tests/test_docs.py; run it with --update-mdtest. -->

```text
usage: sqlty [-h] [--version] {rewrite,strip,check,rule,version} ...

Type-safe SQL queries for Python.

positional arguments:
  {rewrite,strip,check,rule,version}
    rewrite             Rewrite "--sql ..." strings into SQL[T]("--sql ...") calls
    strip               Strip SQL[T]("--sql ...") wrappers back to plain "--sql ..." strings
    check               Lint: validate SQL type annotations and detect issues
    rule                Explain a lint rule (sqlty rule stale-type), or list all rules
    version             Print version and exit

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             Print version and exit
```

## `sqlty rewrite`

```text
usage: sqlty rewrite [-h] [--dialect {postgres,sqlite,mysql}] [--schema SCHEMA] [-v] [-q]
                     [--check] [--diff] [--untyped {skip,sentinel}]
                     [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths                 Files or directories to process (default: current directory)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dialect {postgres,sqlite,mysql}
                        SQL dialect (default: postgres)
  --schema SCHEMA       Path to schema .sql file for enhanced inference
  -v, --verbose         Increase verbosity
  -q, --quiet           Suppress non-error output
  --check               Exit 1 if files need rewriting (don't modify files)
  --diff                Show diff without applying changes
  --untyped {skip,sentinel}
                        Row-returning queries of unknown row type: leave unwrapped (skip, default)
                        or wrap as SQL[UNTYPED](...) (sentinel). Config: untyped in [tool.sqlty]
```

## `sqlty strip`

```text
usage: sqlty strip [-h] [--dialect {postgres,sqlite,mysql}] [--schema SCHEMA] [-v] [-q] [--check]
                   [--diff]
                   [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths                 Files or directories to process (default: current directory)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dialect {postgres,sqlite,mysql}
                        SQL dialect (default: postgres)
  --schema SCHEMA       Path to schema .sql file for enhanced inference
  -v, --verbose         Increase verbosity
  -q, --quiet           Suppress non-error output
  --check               Exit 1 if files contain SQL[T](...) wrappers
  --diff                Show diff without applying changes
```

## `sqlty check`

```text
usage: sqlty check [-h] [--dialect {postgres,sqlite,mysql}] [--schema SCHEMA] [-v] [-q] [--fix]
                   [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths                 Files or directories to process (default: current directory)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dialect {postgres,sqlite,mysql}
                        SQL dialect (default: postgres)
  --schema SCHEMA       Path to schema .sql file for enhanced inference
  -v, --verbose         Increase verbosity
  -q, --quiet           Suppress non-error output
  --fix                 Not implemented yet: reports issues without changing files
```

## `sqlty rule`

```text
usage: sqlty rule [-h] [name]

positional arguments:
  name        Rule name, e.g. select-star

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## `sqlty version`

```text
usage: sqlty version [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```
